title: anattalakkhaṇasutta
credit: English: course exercise book, after Bhikkhu Bodhi, The Connected Discourses of the Buddha (Wisdom Publications, 2000).

paras.en:
“What do you think, bhikkhus, is form permanent or impermanent?”
“Impermanent, Bhante.”
“Is what is impermanent suffering or happiness?”
“Suffering, Bhante.”
“Is what is impermanent, suffering, subject to change, fit to be regarded thus: ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self’?”
“No, Bhante.”

“Is feeling … perception … volitional formations … consciousness permanent or impermanent?”
“Impermanent, Bhante.”
“Is what is impermanent suffering or happiness?”
“Suffering, Bhante.”
“Is what is impermanent, suffering, and subject to change fit to be regarded thus: ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self’?”
“No, Bhante.”
